towers.name: Watch tower
towers.blurb: Ballista bolts. Fast, long range, single target.

splits.name: Longbow spire
splits.desc: +30% range. 25% of bolts crit for triple damage.
splits.masteryDesc: +24% damage, +10% crit chance, and crits stagger non-boss foes for 0.35 s.

splits.name: Repeater
splits.desc: Fires more than twice as fast for 70% damage per bolt.
splits.masteryDesc: +24% damage, and every 4th bolt fires a free twin bolt.

towers.name: Forge cannon
towers.blurb: Lobbed shells that burst on the road. Breaks groups and armor.

splits.name: Siege mortar
splits.desc: +50% range, +50% damage, faster shells and wider blast.

splits.name: Scatter gun
splits.desc: Three staggered shells spread along the road.

towers.name: Frost bell
towers.blurb: A ringing pulse that slows everything around it.

splits.name: Glacier
splits.desc: Every pulse freezes foes solid for 1 second.
splits.masteryDesc: +24% pulse damage, +8% pulse range and +0.4 s longer freeze.

splits.name: Chime
splits.desc: Slowed foes take 25% more damage from everything.

towers.name: Storm pylon
towers.blurb: Lightning that jumps between foes. Strong against swarms.

splits.name: Rail
splits.desc: One huge bolt for 5x damage (+35% vs held or frozen foes). No jumps.
splits.masteryDesc: +24% damage, and ignores 30% armor on non-boss targets.

towers.name: Root garden
towers.blurb: Thorns burst up through the road and hold a foe in place.

splits.name: Bramble
splits.desc: Roots catch every foe within a small area.

splits.name: Spore pod
splits.desc: Leaves a poison cloud that hurts foes standing in it.
splits.masteryDesc: +24% cloud damage and +1 s cloud duration.

towers.name: Beacon
towers.blurb: No attack. Its light boosts nearby towers and reveals Shades.

splits.name: War drum
splits.masteryDesc: +8% aura range, +6% aura damage, +8% drum speed.

splits.name: Watchfire
splits.masteryDesc: +8% aura range, +6% aura damage, +10% range boost.

enemies.name: Grub
enemies.blurb: Slow and soft. Comes in crowds.
enemies.answer: Any tower. A Forge cannon clears the crowds.

enemies.name: Skitter
enemies.blurb: Very fast and frail. Fire struggles to catch it.
enemies.answer: Watch tower or Storm pylon. A Frost bell slows the rush.

enemies.name: Shellback
enemies.blurb: Heavy shell. Bolts do half damage, fire cracks it.
enemies.answer: Forge cannon. Bolts do half.

enemies.name: Moth
enemies.blurb: Flies. Cannons and roots cannot reach it, Wren cannot block it.
enemies.answer: Watch tower, Storm pylon or Frost bell. Cannons and roots miss it.

enemies.name: Warden
enemies.blurb: Shields foes near it. Lightning hurts it most.
enemies.answer: Storm pylon on it first, then the foes it shields.

enemies.name: Mender
enemies.blurb: Heals foes around it. Kill it first.
enemies.answer: Kill it first: a Watch tower or Wren.

enemies.name: Shade
enemies.blurb: Unseen until a Beacon or Wren lights it.
enemies.answer: A Beacon or Wren to show it, then any tower.

enemies.name: Splitter
enemies.blurb: Bursts into three Skitters when it dies.
enemies.answer: Forge cannon or Storm pylon for the Skitters it leaves.

enemies.name: Sapper
enemies.blurb: Chews through wrecks and walls to open new roads.
enemies.answer: Root garden, and kill it before it reaches the wreck.

enemies.name: Burrower
enemies.blurb: Digs under the road where nothing can reach it.
enemies.answer: Root garden or Frost bell to catch it above ground.

enemies.name: Ash moth
enemies.blurb: Flies and cannot burn. Frost brings it down.
enemies.answer: Frost bell, Watch tower or Storm pylon. Fire does nothing.

enemies.name: Iron Shellback
enemies.blurb: Armored. Every hit loses a few points. Big hits win.
enemies.answer: Big hits: Rail, Siege mortar or Longbow.

enemies.name: Husk
enemies.blurb: A Grub cased in ash. Chip shots barely scratch it; blasts and lightning still work.
enemies.answer: Forge cannon or Storm pylon.

enemies.name: Cinder Hound
enemies.blurb: Lunges at double speed every few seconds. A slowed or held Hound cannot lunge.
enemies.answer: Frost bell or Root garden to stop the lunge, plus Watch tower or Storm pylon.

enemies.name: Glasshide
enemies.blurb: Three glass panes each stop one hit. Strip them with fast hits, then land the big ones.
enemies.answer: Fast hits to break panes (Repeater, Tesla crown, Spore pod, Frost bell), then big hits.

enemies.name: Veil Moth
enemies.blurb: Flies unseen. Only a Beacon or Wren's lantern shows it to your towers.
enemies.answer: A Beacon on its flight line, plus Watch tower, Frost bell or Storm pylon.

enemies.name: Hollow Ram
enemies.blurb: Stamps and stuns towers near it. Pin it with roots or frost so it cannot stamp.
enemies.answer: Root garden or Glacier to pin it, plus Rail, Longbow or Siege mortar.

enemies.name: Herald
enemies.blurb: Foes near it shrug off your most used element. Mix elements, or let Wren take it.
enemies.answer: Mix elements, or send Wren.

enemies.name: The Mire King
enemies.blurb: Drags the swamp with him and spits out Grubs.
enemies.answer: Steady damage, and clear the Grubs he spits out.

enemies.name: The Tidewyrm
enemies.blurb: Dives under the tide to heal. Hit it while it is up.
enemies.answer: Storm pylon while it is above water.

enemies.name: The Brass Colossus
enemies.blurb: Brass plates turn most damage. Chill it and the plates crack.
enemies.answer: Frost bell to crack the plates, then everything.

enemies.name: The Hollow Queen
enemies.blurb: Rewrites the map as she falls. Three phases.
enemies.answer: A full mix. She calls Shades, so keep a Beacon.

skills.name: Spear Sweep
skills.desc: Sweeps her spear in a circle. Hits every foe around her.

skills.name: Lantern Snare
skills.desc: Throws a lantern within leash range. Foes inside are rooted and burned for 2 s.

skills.name: Attune
skills.desc: Passive. Towers near Wren attack faster.

skills.name: Sunrise
skills.desc: Every tower fires twice as fast, and every hidden foe shows.

items.name: Cleaving spear
items.desc: Each strike also hits foes beside the target for half damage.

items.name: Brass lantern
items.desc: Wren lights hidden foes 100 px further away.

items.name: Ember spear
items.desc: +22 damage. Strikes burn foes and sunder armor (+25% damage taken).

items.name: Dawn mantle
items.desc: +220 health, 15% less damage taken, +6 regen, and nearby towers deal 12% more damage.

items.name: Second dawn
items.desc: The first time Wren falls, she stands right back up. Used up.

runes.name: Double damage
runes.desc: Wren and towers near her hit twice as hard.

trees.name: Towerworks
trees.blurb: Stronger foundations, wider arcs and cheaper iron.

nodes.name: Sharp bolts
nodes.desc: Watch towers deal 18% more damage.

nodes.name: Hot iron
nodes.desc: Cannon blasts are 22% wider.

nodes.name: Deep chill
nodes.desc: Frost bells slow 15% stronger.

nodes.name: Long arcs
nodes.desc: Lightning jumps to one more foe.

nodes.name: Old roots
nodes.desc: Roots hold foes 0.5 s longer.

nodes.name: Masonry
nodes.desc: Every tower build and upgrade costs 10% less.

nodes.name: Grand architect
nodes.desc: Capstone: every tower deals 18% more damage.

nodes.name: High sightlines
nodes.desc: Capstone: every tower gains 14% range.

trees.name: Armory
trees.blurb: Elemental rounds loaded into towers and shared with Wren.

nodes.name: Ember rounds
nodes.desc: Load a tower with ember rounds: hits burn for 2 s.

nodes.name: Frost rounds
nodes.desc: Load a tower with frost rounds: hits chill the foe.

nodes.name: Storm rounds
nodes.desc: Load a tower with storm rounds: hits can chain to a nearby foe.

nodes.name: Shatter
nodes.desc: Chilled foes take 50% more fire damage.

nodes.name: Overload
nodes.desc: Lightning on rooted or frozen foes jumps +2 times (Rail +35%).

nodes.name: Borrowed edge
nodes.desc: Cross-tree: Wren inherits the loaded round of the nearest loaded tower.

nodes.name: Breach cores
nodes.desc: Capstone: every tower ignores 50% of foe armor.

nodes.name: Chain conductor
nodes.desc: Capstone: Storm lightning jumps to +2 more foes and all towers attack 8% faster.

trees.name: Wren
trees.blurb: Spear craft, field control and Keep synergies.

nodes.name: Spearwork
nodes.desc: Spear Sweep deals 30% more damage.

nodes.name: Bounty hunter
nodes.desc: Last hits pay 30% extra bonus gold.

nodes.name: Long snare
nodes.desc: Lantern Snare holds 0.5 s longer.

nodes.name: Bright attune
nodes.desc: Attune gives towers +10% faster attack speed.

nodes.name: Veteran
nodes.desc: Wren starts every battle at level 3.

nodes.name: Kindled steel
nodes.desc: Cross-tree: Spear Sweep and Lantern Burn shatter chilled foes (+50%).

nodes.name: Dawn champion
nodes.desc: Capstone: Wren starts every stage 2 levels higher.

nodes.name: Keeper's vow
nodes.desc: Capstone: Attune gives +18% attack speed and Sunrise lasts +2 s.

trees.name: Bulwark
trees.blurb: Keep defenses, tactical field timing and recovery.

nodes.name: Thick walls
nodes.desc: +10 lives every stage.

nodes.name: War chest
nodes.desc: +80 starting gold.

nodes.name: Field salvage
nodes.desc: Selling a tower returns 85% instead of 70%.

nodes.name: Early bell
nodes.desc: Calling a wave early pays 50% more gold.

nodes.name: Iron gate
nodes.desc: The first non-boss leak each wave costs no lives.

nodes.name: Runic echo
nodes.desc: Cross-tree: Claiming a Rune grants +3 s Attune surge everywhere.

nodes.name: Bastion bell
nodes.desc: Capstone: Keep Gate emits a shockwave pushing/stunning nearby foes on first leak + +8 lives.

nodes.name: Royal coffers
nodes.desc: Capstone: +180 starting gold every stage.

regions.name: Ashen Rift
regions.rule: Lava, high ground and the Queen

stages.name: Lantern Road
stages.twist: Drag Wren onto the road to hold the crossing. Rebuild the ruined bend plot with gold or Wren field work.

alt.name: Uphill March
alt.twist: The Hollow marches backward from the Keep end toward the western woods.

stages.name: Fork in the Moss
stages.twist: The roads cross in a central pinwheel. At Wave 5 the moss pond drains and a third north rift breaches.

terraforms.label: The moss pond drains! A northern breach tears open!

alt.name: Dusk on the Bog
alt.twist: Night falls on even waves, the north breach awakens on Wave 2, and inner bends start ruined.

waves.hint: Fast packs from north and west

stages.name: Switchback Hill
stages.twist: The road plunges north-to-south down terraced cliffs. Clear spine boulders or brace for the Wave 5 scree chute.

alt.name: Uphill Climb
alt.twist: Foes climb upward from the southern basin toward the cliff summit.

stages.name: Firefly Night
stages.twist: Opposite pincers meet in the dark. Unlit shrines hide plots until cleared, and an eastern breach wakes at Wave 5.

alt.name: Long Dusk
alt.twist: The eastern breach opens on Wave 2 and fallen shrines bury two more plots.

stages.name: The Mire King
stages.twist: Boss. The swamp swallows outer plots while draining its moat at Wave 5; when the King wakes, an inner causeway opens.
stages.unlocks: Storm pylon & Relic: Mire crown (+10% tower damage)

terraforms.label: The crescent moat drains, uncovering a dry island mound!
The Mire King smashes an inner causeway straight to the Keep!

alt.name: Sunken Crown
alt.twist: Night falls on even waves and sinkholes swallow two more plots at Wave 5.

stages.name: Low Tide
stages.twist: Two tidal islands feeding west. Pull the Harbor Boom to seal the north bridge, or watch the Wave 6 cliff detour open.

shifts.label: The tide floods the south ford

alt.name: Rip Tide
alt.twist: The cliff detour wakes on Wave 2 and tidal sandbars bury inner plots under coastal ruins.

stages.name: Shipwreck Cove
stages.twist: Salvage cove wrecks for plots, trigger the Shoal Boom gate, and defend when Wave 5 ebb tide drains the harbor reef.

terraforms.label: Ebb tide exposes the outer reef road and sandbar!

alt.name: Westward Landing
alt.twist: Every landing reverses: waves come ashore at the west cove and march east, and the outer reef opens on Wave 2.

stages.name: Lighthouse Rock
stages.twist: 360° sea-stack siege onto the central Lighthouse island. Clear citadel ruins before Wave 6 wakes the sea-cave tunnel.

alt.name: Blackout Beacon
alt.twist: Night settles on even waves and the sea-cave tunnel opens on Wave 2.

stages.name: Storm Shelf
stages.twist: Monsoon rain weakens fire and doubles lightning arc reach. Pull the Viaduct Gate on the figure-8 overpass or watch the Wave 6 cutoff.

alt.name: Backwash Squall
alt.twist: The storm climbs in reverse from the south-east shelf to the north-west summit, and the flash-flood cutoff opens on Wave 3.

stages.name: The Tidewyrm
stages.twist: Boss. Two east bridges alternate under rising tides. At Wave 5 the eastern strait drains into a central shoal; at 50% HP the Tidewyrm seals the north pass.
stages.unlocks: Relic: Tide pearl (+15% tower range near water)

shifts.label: High tide on the north-east bridge
High tide on the south-east bridge

terraforms.label: Ebb tide exposes the center coral shoal!
The Tidewyrm drowns the north pass. Everything comes by the south bridge and the shoal!

alt.name: King Tide
alt.twist: Tides surge every 40 seconds instead of 50, and driftwood ruins block the coral island plots.

stages.name: Conveyor Hall
stages.twist: Three vertical drop-shafts with fast belts. Pull the Foundry Brake to slow the center belt, or clear jammed cranes.

alt.name: Express Shift
alt.twist: Conveyors reverse from south-east to north-west and the overhead transfer chute opens on Wave 2.

stages.name: Gear Garden
stages.twist: Dual interlocking cogwheels with A/B gears. Flip the Pinion Clutch at center to redirect spurs once Wave 5 unlocks.

alt.name: Inverted Gears
alt.twist: A and B gear cycles swap waves and the west gear spur engages at Wave 2.

stages.name: Steam Vents
stages.twist: Two central rifts split outward to opposing West and East gates! Stand Wren on steam vents for 2x blast tempo.

alt.name: Overpressure Boiler
alt.twist: The centre exhaust pipe opens on Wave 2 and the Hollow adapts every 2 waves.

stages.name: Assembly Line
stages.twist: Tri-bay diagonal lanes feed the NW Crucible. Use rail switches to force long loops; clear cranes & brace for Wave 5 drop chutes.

alt.name: Reverse Dispatch
alt.twist: The foundry reverses: foes pour from NW out toward N, E and S docks.

stages.name: The Brass Colossus
stages.twist: Boss. 320° siege ring around the elevated Hex Anvil Dais. Chill the Colossus to shatter brass plates; when he rages, he smashes open the center.
stages.unlocks: Relic: Brass heart (+1 Wren skill point)

terraforms.label: The Colossus smashes straight through the central Anvil Dais!

alt.name: Cold Iron Blackout
alt.twist: Night falls on even waves and the central cut breaches early on Wave 3.

stages.name: Ember Pass
stages.twist: Diagonal caldera bridges cycling under magma shifts. Seal the center Obsidian Gate or anticipate the Wave 6 ash portal.

alt.name: Triple Eruption
alt.twist: Night settles through ash clouds and NE summit descends toward SW.

stages.name: Avalanche Ridge
stages.twist: NE→W→SE horseshoe around a collapsing high ridge. Wave 4 cracks a steep scree slide while avalanches bury plots.

terraforms.label: A rockslide carves a steep scree pass down the ridge!

alt.name: Ridge Reversal
alt.twist: Foes surge upward from the southern basin onto the crumbling eastern peak, on the ridge road and the scree alike.

stages.name: Mirror Lake
stages.twist: A centre rift feeds two opposite spirals, to a north-east and a south-west Keep. The Rift Divert sends the whole horde down one spiral at a time, and Wave 5 cools a third bridge.

terraforms.label: North magma lake cools into a stone cross-bridge!

alt.name: Inverted Reflections
alt.twist: The outer corners become the rifts and every spiral feeds inward to one centre Keep.

waves.hint: North lake cools into a bridge!

stages.name: The Hollow Gate
stages.twist: Four-corner radial crucible converging on the Center Keep. Rifts awaken wave by wave while the Hollow adapts every wave.

alt.name: All Four From Dawn
alt.twist: All four corner rifts are lit from Wave 1 and each sends its own splinter of the horde.

stages.name: The Hollow Queen
stages.twist: Final boss. 4 Cathedral naves around a central Royal Altar. At Wave 4 inner naves crack open; each Queen phase breaks a new path & floods the floor.

terraforms.label: The central west cloister tears open!
Queen Phase 1: The eastern causeway shatters open!
Queen Phase 2: Magma floods the eastern outer cloister. Everything surges inward!

alt.name: Ashen Eclipse
alt.twist: The Queen shrouds her cathedral in darkness and adapts every 2 waves.
